title: Static Velvet
style: Dark moody alternative R&B slow jam meets industrial synth, 100 BPM, heavy distorted analog synth bass, cinematic brooding pads, sparse hard-hitting drums, smoky atmosphere, brooding falsetto male vocal, intimate and menacing late-night mood
negativeTags: country, happy, acoustic, chiptune, upbeat pop, EDM drop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Static in the velvet dark
You leave a burn but not a mark
Red light humming on the wall
I hear you even when you don't call

[Chorus]
Static velvet, wrap me tight
Pull me under through the night
Static velvet on my skin
Every time I let you in

[Verse 2]
Machines are breathing in the floor
You say you're leaving, then want more
Cold steel heartbeat, slow and low
Tell me something I don't know

[Bridge]
Don't turn the lights on
Don't turn the lights on

[Chorus]
Static velvet, wrap me tight
Pull me under through the night
